post.description: Device authorization (RFC 8628, §3.1): a machine without a browser asks for a device code and a user code. Its person approves the user code on the verification page, `GET /device`, within `expires_in` seconds, the server setting `--device-code-lifetime`; the machine meanwhile polls `POST /auth/token` every `interval` seconds, the server setting `--device-poll-interval`.

200.description: A new device code and its user code.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version (`application/problem+json`), or the request (`application/json`, RFC 6749, §5.2): `invalid_request` without a `client_id` or with one twice, `invalid_client` with another `client_id`.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

get.description: Opened by the browser. Sends it to GitHub's authorization page, asking for no scope, with a `state` that the cookie this response sets binds to this browser. The `state` works once, until it expires; its lifetime is the server setting `--sign-in-state-lifetime`.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: The page of this server to return to once signed in: a path such as `/settings?tab=devices`. Anything else, such as another site's address, returns to `/`.

Location.description: GitHub's authorization page with the app's client ID, the callback `<public URL>/auth/github/callback` and `state`.

Set-Cookie.description: The cookie that binds `state` to this browser: `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure` under an https public URL, for the callback's path only.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

get.description: Opened by the browser on its way back from GitHub. Checks `state` against the browser's cookie, exchanges `code` with the app's client ID and secret and reads the GitHub user. The first sign-in of a GitHub user creates an account with the user's GitHub ID as its GitHub sign-in method; later ones reach the account that holds that method and update the method's GitHub login. Keeps no GitHub token.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: GitHub's error, such as `access_denied`, instead of a code.

200.description: Signed in: a page that sends the browser to the sign-in's return page.

Set-Cookie.description: The session cookie `skald_session`: `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict`, `Secure` under an https public URL; and the removal of the cookie that bound `state`.

400.description: No one is signed in: `state` is missing, wrong, from another browser, expired or used, or GitHub gave no code or refused it.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

500.description: No one is signed in: the database failed.

502.description: No one is signed in: GitHub failed or refused the app's client ID and secret.

post.summary: Poll for a device flow's session token
post.description: The token endpoint (RFC 8628, §3.4): the machine polls with its device code, at most once per `interval` seconds, until its person approves or denies the user code or the codes expire. An approved code gives a session token once; every later poll for it answers `invalid_grant`.

200.description: The person approved the user code: the session token for their account.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version (`application/problem+json`), or gives no token (`application/json`, RFC 8628, §3.5): `authorization_pending` until the person decides; `slow_down` to a poll less than `interval` seconds after the previous one; `access_denied` once the person denied the code; `expired_token` once the codes expired; `invalid_grant` for an unknown device code or one that already gave its token; `invalid_request`, `invalid_client` or `unsupported_grant_type` for a malformed request.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

get.description: Opened by the person's browser at `verification_uri` or `verification_uri_complete`. With a web session, it names the account's username, says that approving signs a machine in to that account and asks for the user code, filled in from `user_code`, with the buttons Approve and Deny, which submit `POST /device`. Opening it decides nothing.

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: The user code to fill in.

200.description: The page that asks for the code; without a web session, a link to sign in with GitHub that returns to this page.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

post.summary: Approve or deny a user code
post.description: Submitted by the verification page's form, with the web session's cookie, from a page of this server: a request whose `Origin` is another site's, or that has none, decides nothing. Approving binds the code to the session's account; a user code works once, for one account. After 10 wrong, used or expired codes within 15 minutes, the account's codes, right ones included, are refused until fewer remain in that window.

400.description: The code is wrong, used or expired, or the form has no decision.

403.description: The request has no web session, or comes from another site.

404.description: GitHub sign-in is off: the server has no GitHub settings.

429.description: Too many wrong codes: the account's codes are refused for a while.

200.description: The devices of the session's account, each with its certificate as the device sent it, or `null` while it has none.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version.

401.description: The request has no session, or an unknown one, or an `Authorization` header that is not `Bearer <token>`.

post.description: A new device registers its ID and public keys with its account (docs/protocol/membership.md, "Linking a device"). Only `client` devices register here.

200.description: The same registration again, by the same account: a retry after a lost answer.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version (`ProtocolProblem`), or the registration is invalid: a malformed body, an ID not derived from `signing`, a kind other than `client`, a key not of 32 bytes or a `name` not of 1 to 64 bytes.

401.description: The request has no session, or an unknown one, or an `Authorization` header that is not `Bearer <token>`.

409.description: The server has the ID with other keys or `name`, or on another account.

200.description: The server accepts the stated version.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version.

delete.description: Signs a machine out: ends the device session of the request's bearer token at once, so that every later request with it is refused. The account's other sessions, its devices and its master key stay.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version.

401.description: The request has no `Authorization` header, one that is not `Bearer <token>`, or the token of no device session, such as an ended one.

get.description: Opens a WebSocket (RFC 6455) after checking the protocol version the request states, as docs/protocol/README.md, "Server answers", says. The connection carries no frames yet.

parameters.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
parameters.description: Offers the subprotocol `skald.<n>`, which states protocol version n.

101.description: The server accepts the stated version and selects its subprotocol.

400.description: The server refuses the stated version (`application/problem+json`), or the request is not a WebSocket opening request (`text/plain`).

ProtocolVersion.name: Skald-Protocol-Version
ProtocolVersion.description: The protocol version the request states.

NoStore.description: `no-store`: the response holds a sign-in's codes, token or outcome.

session.name: skald_session
session.description: The web session that a GitHub sign-in gives.

bearer.description: The session token that the device flow gives: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

AccountId.description: An account's ID: a UUIDv7 in the lowercase hyphenated form (docs/protocol/README.md, "Identifiers").

Certificate.description: A device certificate's CBOR bytes (docs/protocol/membership.md, "Device certificate") in base64url without padding (RFC 4648, §5).

cert.description: The certificate as the device sent it; `null` while it has none.

device_code.description: The secret the machine polls with.

user_code.description: The code the person types: 8 letters from `BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ` as `XXXX-XXXX`. The verification page ignores case and every character but letters and digits.

verification_uri_complete.description: The verification page with the user code filled in: `<public URL>/device?user_code=<user code>`.

interval.description: The least number of seconds between polls.

user_code.description: The user code as the person typed it.

DeviceId.description: A device's ID: a UUIDv8 derived from its signing key, in the lowercase hyphenated form (docs/protocol/README.md, "Identifiers").

signing.description: The Ed25519 public key the ID derives from.

name.description: 1 to 64 bytes of UTF-8, set on the device; its certificate's `name`.

access_token.description: The session token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

master.description: The account's master public key; `null` while it has none.

cert.description: The certificate of the device, issued by the master key.

ProtocolProblem.description: A problem details object (RFC 9457) that refuses the stated protocol version.

PublicKey.description: An Ed25519 or X25519 public key: 32 bytes in base64url without padding (RFC 4648, §5).

github_login.description: The GitHub login of the account's GitHub sign-in method as of its latest sign-in, for display; only while the account has one.

SupportedVersions.description: The protocol versions the server accepts, ascending.

Username.description: An account's username: a `name` of an agent address (docs/protocol/README.md, "Agent address"), unique on the server; `skald`, `admin`, `support` and `root` are reserved.
